name: @cameronapak/platform-sdk
description: TypeScript SDK for the YouVersion Platform API

scripts.check:cli: pnpm check:cli-generated && pnpm build && pnpm --dir packages/cli build && pnpm --dir packages/cli typecheck && node --test packages/cli/test/*.test.mjs && pnpm --dir packages/cli pack --dry-run
scripts.check:python: uv sync --project packages/python --frozen --no-install-project && uv run --project packages/python --no-sync python packages/python/check.py
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && cp src/generated/sdk-map.json dist/generated/sdk-map.json
scripts.build:all: pnpm build && pnpm --dir packages/react-query build && pnpm --dir packages/cli build
scripts.test: pnpm build:all && node --test test/*.test.mjs packages/react-query/test/*.test.mjs packages/cli/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm generate:react-query --check && pnpm check:cli-generated && pnpm build:all && pnpm typecheck && pnpm typecheck:test && pnpm --dir packages/react-query typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/react-query typecheck:test && pnpm --dir packages/cli typecheck && node --test test/*.test.mjs packages/react-query/test/*.test.mjs packages/cli/test/*.test.mjs && pnpm pack --dry-run && pnpm --dir packages/react-query pack --dry-run && pnpm --dir packages/cli pack --dry-run
